work_item: W102 independent review of W97 current-owner part finish alias candidate

findings.title: W97 alias path rejects W98 current-session composite fingerprints
findings.evidence: The W97 owner validator at candidate line 1600 requires /^file-sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/i, despite the exact same proof's committed fingerprint being checked against both stored owner source and current source. With only the fingerprint changed on the controlled current-owner fixture, the W97 contract is 11/12 for file SHA (the unrelated known gloss parser case is the sole failure), and 7/12 for composite-sha256 and 7/12 for composite-fnv1a32. The four valid owner alias operations—roof chrome, roof satin, ordinary roof chrome, and same-roof hood alias—become zero-edit refusals. Partial, stale, duplicate, manual, hidden, and mixed proof refusal controls continue to pass.
findings.recommended_boundary: Allow the current-session proof path to accept the same three exact tagged fingerprint forms already validated by W98 (file-sha256, composite-sha256, composite-fnv1a32), while retaining exact current/stored source equality and every other freshness/uniqueness/mask/layer/appearance check. Keep durable saved-memory identity file-SHA-only.

findings.title: Requested layer selector is overwritten without an equivalence check
findings.evidence: The W97 candidate line 1622 assigns planned.region = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(reuse.selector)) after checking only the semantic part and owner proof. The candidate does not compare the planned request's pre-rewrite layer selector/layer IDs with reuse.proof.layers.ids or the owner selector before replacement. A source-layer request that parses to a part + different layer could therefore be silently redirected to the saved owner's layer. The W97 fixture uses a single Car Paint layer and does not exercise an explicitly different requested layer, so this is a source-level route gap, not a claimed dynamic reproduction.
findings.recommended_boundary: Before rewriting, resolve the planned selector's explicitly requested layer IDs uniquely; if explicit IDs differ from the proof's exact owner IDs, return a truthful zero-queue refusal. Only canonicalize aliases when the requested layer is absent or exactly matches the proved layer set.

verified.composite_sha_current_owner_route: 7/12; four intended positive owner aliases fail closed.
verified.composite_fnv_current_owner_route: 7/12; same four intended positive owner aliases fail closed.
verified.negative_proof_controls: The producer harness continues to refuse its partial, stale-source, duplicate, manual, stale-layout, hidden-body-layer, and mixed-paint fixtures under all three fingerprint forms.
verified.proof_carry: W97 queueEditZones places the fresh proof on the edit request at line 1682. Candidate makeTools strips internal fields from user-facing edit args but validates the proof/current owner before queue insertion at lines 370-371; the apply queue rechecks current proof/owner at lines 640-648. This was source-reviewed, not executed through applyQueue.

w98_regex_audit.result: W98 compatibility regex is narrowly tagged and its test passed 10 oracle cases with limits.
w98_regex_audit.durable_gate: The W89 durable layered identity gate still rejects both composite forms and accepts file SHA; W97's extra strong-hash restriction is the compatibility gap.
